main_text.l: A.C.1600. De hâc miserabili calamitate videatur Historia Indiæ Orientalis Petri Iarrigi. Hodie ta-men regnum Pegu ita iterum floret, ut nulla tantæ cladis superfit memo-ria.
Hic aliquoties urbem Bataviam frustrà obsedit.

page.notes: The marginal note "Indiæ / Insula-næ re-gna." is set across four lines and is transcribed as one note "Insula-næ regna." with its printed hyphen kept. The "4." beside REGNUM PEGU is a section number in the margin. A small stray mark beside "Orientalis" is not text and is omitted. The year "1600" and the name "Iarrigi" are copied as printed. The edge of the facing page at the right and the faint show-through of the reverse page are excluded.
